title: Choose a modern Class Finance dashboard direction
question: How does the Fintrack-inspired layout feel when adapted to Class Finance colors and workflows? Choose the mockup that should move forward, or ask for a revision. All values shown are labeled examples.

options.label: Fluent Finance Workspace
options.lineage: A native Windows control surface with concise system panels
options.thesis: A focused desktop workspace makes available kas, outstanding bills, and recent transactions easy to scan and act on.
materials: Segoe UI Variable with Cascadia Code for figures
options.viewport: A persistent left rail opens to Ringkasan. A slim application header leads into one wide Kas tersedia band, a compact Perlu perhatian queue at the right, and a clearly columned Transaksi terbaru grid below.
options.risk: It can feel like standard Windows admin software if the system surfaces and status chips become interchangeable.

raised.raise: Align student, amount, and status columns to fixed stops for rapid comparison.
Keep the active section and the full set of destinations visible in the persistent navigation.
Give each payment state one concise label and a direct follow-up path.
Keep groups and rupiah totals visually bounded, with every amount right-aligned.
Give the highest-priority payment issue a clear place in the attention queue.

options.label: Rekening Digital
options.lineage: A contemporary online banking account overview
options.thesis: The class fund reads as one digital account, with a clear balance, outstanding dues, and a precise statement of movements.
options.viewport: A compact account header carries Kas tersedia and the active bill totals; a labeled student follow-up list sits beside it, with a dense statement below. Navigation remains steady at the left.
options.risk: Banking patterns are familiar, but the account summary could overpower student-level details if it takes too much space.

options.label: Signal Tiles
options.lineage: A flat modern operating-system tile canvas
options.thesis: Distinct color fields turn kas, active bills, unpaid students, and recent movements into a crisp, modern technical overview.
options.viewport: A broad Kas tersedia field leads; smaller panels summarize bills and unpaid students. A student attention list and the latest transaction rows remain addressable in a lower zone.
options.case: It holds the modern digital character and can make the main figures clear; the tile hierarchy needs careful restraint to keep dues and student names easy to compare.
options.risk: Large type and high-contrast tiles can compete with the detailed payment work.

options.label: Departure Board
options.case: Clear data columns fit payment states, but the physical display rhythm feels retro beside a modern desktop app.
options.kept: Keep amounts and payment states aligned in fixed columns.

options.label: Tabbed Software Manual
options.lineage: A clear overlay on a color-coded reference manual
options.case: Distinct section layers help orientation, but manual-like transparency adds visual noise to everyday bookkeeping.
options.kept: Make the active section visible and keep navigation extent clear.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.case: Strong directional hierarchy could clarify follow-up actions, but its vivid signage palette overwhelms financial comparison.
options.kept: Give each payment state one concise next action.

options.label: Technical Track Sheet
options.lineage: A ruled side-by-side cassette track listing
options.case: The bounded lists and aligned durations translate well to rows, while the analog, handwritten character moves away from the requested modern look.
options.kept: Bound related rows and align each amount.

options.label: Full-Screen Status Feed
options.case: One prominent item gives focus, but hiding the rest of the balance and ledger slows this multi-record desktop task.
options.kept: Give the top-priority item a clear visual place.

options.label: Fintrack Layout, Class Finance Colors
options.lineage: A dark finance dashboard with summary cards, a cash-flow chart, a focused attention panel, and a transaction table
options.thesis: A familiar finance hierarchy puts the class cash, student follow-up, cash-flow trend, and latest movements in one view.
options.viewport: A compact left rail leads to three summary cards, a broad Arus Kas chart, a right-side Perlu Perhatian list and Tagihan aktif summary, then a searchable Transaksi terbaru table.
options.case: Adapts the supplied Fintrack hierarchy to Class Finance, replacing bank-card and spending widgets with the existing student follow-up and active bill workflows while keeping the app palette.
options.risk: The chart needs a useful empty state when transaction history is too small to show a meaningful trend.

canonCard.label: The category-standard dashboard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar finance admin layout puts summary metrics above a student balance table.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional left navigation, a top balance summary, student payment statuses, and a recent transactions table.
canonCard.risk: Easy to scan, but visually similar to most admin dashboards.
